title: fix(cli): correct the output option in help text
body:
## Summary
Correct the help string from --ouput to --output in cli/help.js; the parser and option behavior are unchanged.

## Testing
Validation plan: print the help string and confirm it matches the parser's existing --output option.

## Limitations
This only changes help text; option parsing and validation are outside scope.

## Breaking changes
None; the accepted option remains --output.
